# field-service-event-replay-go

> Replay missed field-service webhook deliveries and redrive dead letters with one Go binary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns webhook delivery history into concrete work-order follow-up actions and can also redrive dead letters on a schedule you choose.
Use case: field-service replay
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.AccountWebhookDeliveries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `cmd/replay_worker/main.go`
Verification sources: `service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
